presentation: BeeSave template mark; original geometry, app palette and consistent container

RU.basis: Top twenty by published gross assets in the ranking; banks with withheld reports are not ranked.

US.basis: Domestically chartered banks ranked by consolidated assets; published 2026-10-02.

GB.basis: Published assets ranking of UK banks and building societies; reporting dates vary by institution. Snapshot covers institutions with published 2025 figures; this is not an exhaustive ranking of all UK-authorised firms.

CA.basis: OSFI M4 consolidated balance sheets, DPA 1045 total assets. Federally regulated Canadian bank entities (including Bank Act federal credit unions) and licensed foreign branches; local branch reports, not worldwide parent assets. Aggregate industry rows excluded. July is the latest complete common month; August is partial.

AU.basis: APRA MADIS Table 1, total resident assets on Australian books, consistently for domestic ADIs and Australian foreign-bank operations. Ranking uses Australian resident assets, not worldwide group assets. Industry total excluded. Source attribution: APRA, licensed under CC BY 3.0 Australia.

BR.basis: Banco Central do Brasil IF.data, institutions individually (TipoInstituicao=3), Resumo/Ativo Total. Active individual bank entities in B1/B2/B4; non-bank institutions, holdings and conglomerate totals excluded. Bank subsidiaries are distinct regulated legal entities. Equity in subsidiaries follows the regulator unconsolidated reporting basis.

AR.basis: BCRA official Activos ranking July 2026, local regulated entities; amounts in thousand ARS. Official abbreviated names retained as search aliases. Naranja Digital Compania Financiera is excluded as a non-bank finance company; BICE advances into the twenty bank entities. The ranking is recomputed consecutively after that exclusion. Exclusion provenance: https://www.naranjax.com/atencion-usuarios-financieros. Permanent BCRA codes and full legal denominations reconciled to the January 2026 BCRA entity publication and the July 2026 official active entity list. Display brand BICE is retained; the official legal denomination of code 00300 is Banco de Inversion y Comercio Exterior S.A. Citibank is the local branch entity.

KZ.basis: Common 31 March 2026 separate/non-consolidated total assets, thousand KZT. National Bank of Kazakhstan reporting workbook sheet 01.04.2026 covers 23 second-tier banks (sum of displayed rounded individual assets 70549053693, regulator total 70549053694: rounding difference 1 thousand KZT); combined with the statutory Development Bank of Kazakhstan first-quarter 2026 published separate balance sheet FP uncons, assets 5990030042. DBK consolidated group assets 7609053206 deliberately not used. All 24 entities sorted by separate assets, largest twenty retained; DBK is fourth. Prior catalogue IDs retained; formerly ranked ADCB remains available as an unranked record. Current active status is cross-checked against NBK September 2026 entity reporting. Full current legal denominations of eighteen ranked deposit-taking banks are reconciled to the official KDIF participant list retrieved 8 October 2026, including the complete Otbasy, Home Credit subsidiary and Kazakhstan-Ziraat names. Citibank Kazakhstan legal registration disclosure independently confirms its full legal name and universal licence 1.1.832.138 issued 16 July 2026. The statutory Development Bank uses its own published separate reporting and current official bank site. The obsolete 2022 ARDFM licence attachment is not used as evidence of current licensing.

PE.basis: SBS June 2026 balance sheets B-2201 and B-5102/5103/5104, total assets in thousand PEN. All twenty commercial banks (including Banco Efectiva 2124509.516), three state banking entities Banco de la Nacion, COFIDE and Agrobanco, and separately reported J.P. Morgan Banco de Inversion compared on the same local standalone basis before selecting twenty. JPM official Q2 2026 statement has 519078 thousand PEN, below Banco Ripley cutoff 2137065.477; not worldwide parent assets. Domestic BCP row used, duplicate BCP-with-foreign-branches and aggregate totals excluded. June is the latest common published month of the four SBS reports. Current licensed commercial/state bank names reconciled to the banking section of SBS guarantee issuer register observed in the browser 8 October 2026 (bank-section DOM text snapshot, because CLI access redirected), supplemented by current FSD membership and JPM local operating-license/financial disclosure. Full legal denominations from current SMV company directory; Bank of China also matched by SUNAT RUC in SMV, ICBC full name in SBS, Santander Consumer Bank legal name and RUC in its official current disclosure. Four below-cut banks retained as active unranked records. Existing twenty catalogue IDs retained.

IN.basis: S&P Global Market Intelligence, Top 20 banks in India by total assets, compiled 6 June 2024; all financial data at 31 March 2024, billion USD at end-of-period exchange rates. Published pro forma methodology for announced bank mergers; IDFC FIRST assets include the publisher's USD 1.61 billion IDFC adjustment. Bank legal names and active presence checked against the current RBI Banks in India register. Group and bank names are not added twice.

CN.basis: Mainland China bank legal entities, consolidated total assets at 31 December 2024 in million CNY. KPMG China Banking Survey 2025 annual-report asset table, commercial banks positions 1–17, combined with official 2024 consolidated accounts of China Development Bank (ChinaMoney issuer disclosure), Agricultural Development Bank of China and Export-Import Bank of China (Shanghai Stock Exchange issuer disclosure). Policy/development banks included, no separate financial holding entity added. Mainland entities only: Hong Kong/Macao institutions and global foreign parent assets excluded. Chinese legal names, English names and permanent institution codes reconciled to the NFRA legal-entity register at 31 December 2025, published 14 August 2026. Consolidated CDB 18618341, ADBC 10650455 and Exim 6467358; standalone bank columns not mixed with consolidated assets.

MX.basis: CNBV June 2026 statistical bulletins: commercial EF Resumen row ACTIVO and development Activos June 2026 column. Common consolidated bank-with-subsidiaries basis, not financial holding companies or worldwide foreign parents. All 53 operating commercial banks plus all six statutory development banks compared numerically before selecting twenty; CIBanco has no June assets (n.a.) and is absent from the current bank-sector registry. Totals reconcile within 0.000001 million MXN spreadsheet floating-point precision. Current full legal names and permanent CASFIM IDs come from the CNBV supervised-entity register retrieved 8 October 2026, restricted to the two bank sectors. Current register has one additional bank, Nubank: official operations authorization 10 July 2026 and commencement 6 August 2026 are after the common June period; it is retained as an active unranked bank, without importing former SOFIPO assets or inventing a June bank rank. No mixing with the newer July commercial-only bulletin.

AO.basis: Individual bank assets at 31 December 2025. Eaglestone Angolan Banks Results 2025, printed page 6, supplies nineteen banks; totals cross-checked against Deloitte Banca em Analise 2026 individual balance sheets (publicly indexed reproduction, printed pages 235-236; methodology pages 147-148). Replace provisional/missing BNI and Access figures with their subsequently published annual accounts for the identical date: BNI individual financial statements PDF page 1, 570220562 thousand AOA; Access annual report PDF page 73 (printed 64), 163548625 thousand AOA, visually transcribed. Both converted to million AOA. All twenty-one banks operating at end-2025 compared, including statutory BDA and local BOCLB branch only. Top twenty exclude Banco Comercial do Huambo (97327 million). Current BNA browser list has stale VTB status and omits ABO: reconcile it with Deloitte cessation/commencement notes and ABO own annual report. VTB stopped operations in first-half 2025 and is retained inactive/unranked. ABO started operations in first-quarter 2026; its pre-opening December 2025 assets of 21893246 thousand AOA (annual report page 64) are below the cutoff, and the current active bank is retained unranked. Standard Chartered Angola merged into Access in October 2024, not a separate bank. No worldwide foreign-parent or holding-company assets.

ZA.basis: Common 31 March 2025 bank-level total assets. SARB BA900 public individual returns, table 13 item 277 column 5 (domestic plus foreign assets of the reporting South African bank/local licensed branch), thousand ZAR; no foreign-parent or banking-holding-company assets. Statutory DBSA, Land Bank and Postbank supplemented by their official separate/company annual balance sheets for the identical date. BA900 uses regulatory statistical presentation; statutory bank accounts use their published accounting presentation, all on a bank-level total-asset basis. March 2025 is the latest completely evidenced common annual slice; newer March/July 2026 returns and DBSA/Land Bank accounts were reviewed but a primary Postbank 2026 statement was not available, so they are not mixed into this ranking. Current licensed identities reconciled against SARB locally controlled July 2026, foreign controlled, September 2026 foreign-branch and mutual lists. Tyme Bank is now GoTyme Bank; FNB/RMB/WesBank are brands/divisions of FirstRand Bank, not additional banks. HSBC transferred its South African business to FirstRand on 27 February 2026 and is absent from the current foreign-branch register; retained inactive, unranked. Sasfin relinquished its licence effective 30 June 2026; VBS and Habib Overseas are in liquidation, retained inactive. eNL has zero/pre-launch assets in the selected period and is current, unranked. Compare all other current BA900 entities plus three statutory banks: Albaraka is twentieth (9825492), Postbank next (9728748). The cooperative-bank sector together has 583 million ZAR in its February 2025 statutory fiscal-year reporting (PA 2025/26, printed page 50), far below the cutoff; used only as a coverage check, not a differently dated ranking row. Small-system exception is not used.

DZ.basis: Rachid Sekak / Sekak Conseils, original full-market compilation of published bank financial statements for 2024, published with the author’s Monographie de la place bancaire algérienne (Twala, 1 August 2025). Feuil1, T Bilan = total balance-sheet assets, billion DZD, local bank legal entities and licensed foreign branches; all twenty operating banks at 31 December 2024 compared, excluding public/private aggregate rows. Author, period, units and underlying published-financial-statement methodology are explicit in the workbook. Figures retain the publisher’s rounding. All twenty are still on the Banque d’Algerie current commercial-bank list and official 4 January 2026 licensed-bank list. Statutory BNH is included (654 billion DZD); former CNL is not a second bank. Ziraat is the twenty-first currently licensed bank but received its bank-branch licence on 16 January 2025, after this common period: it is retained unranked, without worldwide parent assets. Closed CACIB and non-bank financial establishments are excluded. This is a dated 2024 ranking, not a claim about 2026 market shares.

CD.basis: Published comparative local-bank total assets at 31 December 2023: Mapamboli Posa and Kabanga Kadima, Les banques en République Démocratique du Congo, IJFAEMA 7(1), January 2025, Table 1, printed page 72, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14840777. Authors identify original unpublished BCC data and the 2023 period, bank-level total-asset measure and million-USD unit. All fourteen table rows retained, sorted by the asset column (the printed table itself is not fully sorted). Newly opened CRDB is missing from that table and is added from its own audited local 2024 Pillar III report, page 27, 2023 comparative total assets: CDF 125,850,477 thousand, converted at BCC December 2023 end-period interbank rate CDF 2,668.95/USD (2024 annual report, table I.3.34, printed page 147). CRDB is approximately USD 47.15m and follows Solidaire USD 143m; parent-group assets are not used. The fifteen-name operating set reconciles exactly to BCC annual-report Annex 1. Current BCC register has a sixteenth name, MEGABANK DRC SA, absent from the 2023/2024 operating set; it is retained as an additional unranked licensed bank, with no invented earlier assets or affiliation to Taiwanese Mega Bank. Afriland remains a registered bank despite provisional administration and is included. This is a dated 2023 comparison; later Deloitte/issuer figures may differ and are not silently substituted into the common published table.

MN.basis: Dated 31 December 2023 comparison of local individual-bank total net book assets for all twelve commercial banks currently listed by the Bank of Mongolia, plus the separately statutory Development Bank of Mongolia. Bank-level statements and bank-authored annual-result publications; 2024 audited comparative columns retain the 2023 period. The 2023 full-year date is used because Chinggis Khaan Bank has no published 2024 Q4 balance; its 2024 Q3 figure is not mixed with year-end values. Regulatory and IFRS bank-level presentations may differ in accounting adjustments; all values represent total local bank assets, with subsidiaries/parent groups excluded. Rounded bank-authored amounts for Khan, DBM and Arig remain rounded, without invented precision; their rank gaps exceed the reported rounding. Bogd and NIBank original PDF HTTPS downloads failed, so the clearly labelled saved indexed extracts of their own statements are retained with extraction digests, not asserted original-PDF hashes. Every bank carries its individual source and reading basis. This is a 2023 historical comparison, not a current 2026 asset ranking.

TR.basis: 31 December 2025 total net book assets of Turkish licensed bank entities on a bank-only (unconsolidated) basis. All 58 TBB deposit/development/investment-bank rows and all nine TKBB participation-bank individual balance sheets at the same date are compared before selecting twenty. TBB Banks in Türkiye 2025 introductory methodology explicitly identifies audited unconsolidated bank financial statements. TBB million-TRY values are converted exactly to thousand TRY without early rounding; TKBB individual current-period totals are already thousand TRY. Neither foreign worldwide parents nor financial holding groups replace domestic bank entities. Development/investment banks remain eligible. The boundary is Takasbank 322227504 thousand TRY versus Enpara 250148376 thousand TRY. The current BDDK register confirms all twenty selected entities active with permanent EFT codes; the saved registry digest identifies a structured read-only browser DOM extract, not original HTML. The current register contains ten participation banks, while nine have 2025 balances; the newly entering Adil bank has no invented 2025 assets. The zero-asset TBB FUPS row is exempt from 2025 reporting and is retained only in the local comparison, not assigned a positive asset amount or top-twenty place. TKBB notes that audited bank and BDDK presentations may differ; association-published individual statements are used consistently here.

DE.basis: Curated major-bank selection in approximate size order. Current identities checked against primary publications. Not a certified nationwide assets ranking. Individual bank legal entities, HGB annual assets. Parent holding and group IFRS assets excluded. Original source precision retained. J.P. Morgan HGB reconciliation used, rather than its IFRS total.

JP.basis: Curated major-bank selection in approximate size order. Current identities checked against primary publications. Not a certified nationwide assets ranking.

ID.basis: Curated major-bank selection in approximate size order. Current identities checked against primary publications. Not a certified nationwide assets ranking. Available reviewed 2024 individual balances inform ordering; MUFG local assets have not been established. Current names checked separately in 2026.
